UAE retail sales are projected to grow about 5 to 6 percent a year over the next three years, driven by tourism, population growth and the shift to online shopping. E-commerce is expected to reach roughly a quarter of total retail sales by 2028. Prime mall rents in Dubai have risen for six consecutive quarters and vacancy is below 5 percent, so new entrants should plan for high fit-out and rent costs. Foreign retailers can own 100 percent of a mainland company in most sectors, but a local distribution or logistics partner is common practice for the first two years. Typical time from decision to first store opening is 9 to 12 months, mostly for licensing, site selection and fit-out.
